Definition: adverb from the base of G3674; at the same time, i.e. (conjunctionally) notwithstanding, yet still:--and even, nevertheless, though but.
BiblicalUsage: The word hómōs is and even, nevertheless, though but — a small word, used 3 times; John and 1 Corinthians show it in use.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe hómōs needs no more than its plain sense — and even, nevertheless, though but.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
